Introduction to ADAGE AUTOMATION – Leading Provider of Gas Analytical Solutions. 
 
In reference to your requirement for Gas Analytical Solutions, we would like to take this opportunity to briefly introduce 
our organization. 
 
ADAGE AUTOMATION is a global leader in providing Continuous Gas Analytical Systems and Solutions. Our 
expertise spans across applications in Process Monitoring, Emission Monitoring, and Safety for various industrial 
sectors including Oil & Gas, Steel, Cement, Power, Fertilizers, and Chemicals. 
We hold a leadership position in India in terms of business volume and infrastructure. Our strong presence includes: 
• 
16 offices across India 
• 
Three overseas subsidiaries in New Jersey (USA), Abu Dhabi (UAE), and Jubail (Kingdom of Saudi 
Arabia) 
• 
A team of over 300 professionals, including 200+ specialist engineers 
• 
A state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Goa, which is currently the world’s largest Gas Analytical 
Systems Integration (SI) facility 
 
To date, we have successfully installed over 5,000 Analyzer Systems both in India and across the globe. 
We would be delighted to explore how ADAGE can support your gas analytics needs with our proven capabilities, 
global footprint, and commitment to innovation and quality. 
Looking forward to the opportunity to collaborate.

SECTION 2: NOTE, UTILITIES & SCOPE DEFINATION FOR GAS ANALYSIS SYSTEM 
 
• 
External Cabling, Tubing and All Associated Erection Hardware Shall Be in Customer’s Scope. 
• 
All Interconnecting Cables Between analyzers to Sample point location shall be in customer’s Scope. 
• 
Customer shall provide Instrument Air should be oil & moisture free @ 4-6 bar. 
• 
Power Supply Utilities required are: 
• 
Power Supply: 230 VAC, 50 Hz (UPS) 
 230 VAC, 50 Hz (NON- UPS) 
Our Scope of Supply and Work Includes: 
• 
Design, Engineering and Supply of system as per Summary of Prices 
• 
Supervision of Installation and Commissioning of the complete System 
• 
Project Management and Project Documentation 
 
Our Scope of Supply Does Not Include: 
• 
All Erection and Installation Activity. 
• 
Any kind of Civil Work or Mechanical Work. 
• 
Welding of flanges or mounting of purge air unit and instrument on the stack/duct. 
• 
Material Handling at Site, unloading of Analyzers, Internal Shifting from Plant Store to Field 
• 
Loop checking for analog & digital signals. 
• 
Supply and laying of Cable and cable trays for Power supply / Analog and Digital signal / serial 
communication cables ,special Cable etc. 
• 
Laying of trays/structural and support for field tubing. 
• 
All utilities as mentioned above. 
• 
For any delay in commissioning due to reasons not attributed to M/S Adage, commissioning charges shall be 
as per quoted man day.
